theme_and_archetype.rationale: As a utility tool for scanning and verification, this app requires extreme precision, clarity, and authority. The Swiss High-Contrast archetype ensures maximum readability for OCR output fields and minimizes visual distraction.

rules.headings: Use Cabinet Grotesk, font-bold or font-black, tight tracking (tracking-tight). No Inter.
rules.body: Use IBM Plex Sans for maximum legibility of data fields.

rules.monochrome_dominance: 95% of the UI should be grayscale. Use accents only for state (e.g., sync status, confidence scores, primary camera capture button).

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Mobile-first, dense Control Room grid for verification, generous Tetris grid for camera and onboarding.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: p-4 or p-6 on mobile, p-8 on larger screens.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Sharp or minimal (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Maximum 4px radius to maintain the Swiss Brutalist functional feel.

components.dashboard_cards: Flat background (bg-gray-50), 1px solid border (border-gray-200), no shadows.
components.inputs: Use bottom borders only (border-b-2 border-gray-300) or solid light grey blocks with zero border. No rounded input fields.
components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none), high contrast (bg-black text-white or bg-[#002FA7] text-white). Hover states must lighten slightly.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Hard background color changes, no soft fades. e.g., hover:bg-gray-900.
motion_and_interaction.camera_scanner: Use a sweeping tracing beam (Aceternity style) along the ID card frame overlay to indicate active scanning.
motion_and_interaction.loading: Use monospace ASCII-style loaders or sharp geometric spinners.

component_instructions.verification_form: For OCR results, display a confidence score next to each input. Use a green/yellow/red dot or tiny tag (e.g., [98%] or [LOW]). Use Shadcn Input but strip out the rounded corners.
component_instructions.camera_screen: Fullscreen view. Overlay must be bg-black/80 with a clear unmasked rectangle in the center for the ID card. Provide 'Front' and 'Back' step indicators.
component_instructions.sync_status: Use small monospace badges to show local SQLite state vs synced MongoDB state. Example: [ SYNCED ] in green text on light green bg, [ PENDING ] in yellow.
component_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='scan-button', data-testid='employee-list-item'.

general_instructions_for_main_agent: Design for a mobile-first web app experience.
Do not use HTML based components for complex interactions. Rely on customized Shadcn primitives.
Ensure the camera layout looks native-like: strict bounds, camera frame guides, tight integration of action buttons at the bottom.
Strictly adhere to the selected fonts, sizes, and tracking. Avoid Inter completely.
